M45 — 2026-10-13
Bench Claude profile (~/.bench/claude-config) can log itself out mid-round; the runner then refuses to start Claude sessions ('bench profile is not a subscription login'). Check with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.bench/claude-config ~/.bench/claude-<v>/claude auth status`. The login needs the operator's own terminal: the code-paste flow cannot be relayed through script with a closed or piped stdin.
